title: The Lost One's Song
text: A song carries on the wind, thin and broken, a House song every child of yours learns at the hearth. Someone is singing it badly, the way a tired person sings to keep from crying. It could be them. It could be something that heard them.

options.label: Follow the song into the wind.

outcomes.text: Closer. The voice cracks on the same note every time.

options.label: The steadiest voice sings the next verse back.

outcomes.text: The song answers, stronger, as if whoever sings it has remembered they are not alone.

options.label: Keep silent, in case it is a lure.

outcomes.text: It is not. It was one of yours, lost here, and by the time the Leader knows the voice the singing has stopped.
